name: Text Stash – Clipboard History
description:
Clipboard history for text, built for large copies.

Everything you copy is saved to disk and kept for 14 days by default (you can change this), so even multi-megabyte copies survive logouts and restarts. Open the history from the top bar icon, or choose a keyboard shortcut in Settings, then press Enter to paste straight into the app you were using.

Clipboard access: this extension reads the clipboard every time you copy text and stores that text in your home folder (~/.local/share/text-stash). When you pick an item, it puts it back on the clipboard and presses Ctrl+V (Ctrl+Shift+V in terminals) for you. Clipboard data never leaves your computer and is never shared with anyone.

* Searches the full text, even inside very large copies
* Pinned items are never deleted
* Ctrl+1–9 pastes one of the top nine items
* Skips copies that password managers mark as secret
* Pause recording at any time from the top bar menu
* Text only
